how: Halo 3: ODST player configuration (0x98 bytes, native/odst.cpp: player 0's copied, then these bytes laid over it). Decoded live Nov 8 on Crater (Night) Firefight with probe bots (tools/look_probe.py --game odst --spec, three a match: ODST holds 4 players) and their bodies' region permutations (tools/look_units.py --game odst: 16 bytes from biped +0x1358, in the order of the H3ODSTEK objects\characters\odst\odst.render_model regions badge, body, chest (broken, standard), d_head, d_waist, emblem (dutch, on, off), gear (mickey, romeo, dutch, sergeant, standard, johnson), hands, head (johnson, sergeant, romeo, mickey, dutch, off), headgear (mickey, romeo, dutch, sergeant, off), helmet (standard, off), knife (on, off), l_shoulder, r_shoulder (standard, off), splatter (on, off), splatterhead). +0x49 the character: 0 the Rookie (gear standard), 1 Mickey, 2 Dutch, 3 Romeo, 4 Buck (gear sergeant, knife on), 5 Sgt. Johnson, 6 Bug-splattered Buck (splatter on), 7 Injured Romeo (chest broken); 8 and 9 fall back to the Rookie's. +0x46 1 takes the helmet off (helmet region off, the head shows the character's face; the Halo 3 helmet byte). +0x39 primary colour (the chestplate), +0x3A secondary (the shoulder pad and helmet decals), 30 colours (MCC's ODST list, seen working Oct 25). The person's own bytes do not say his look (his read +0x49 0 while he wore Romeo): MCC lays it on its own, which is why every bot was the Rookie in the player's colours (GitHub #15). Dare is not in the squad model and no value gave her. Original: the 2009 characters (Johnson was the pre-order bonus); Modern adds MCC's Bug-splattered Buck and Injured Romeo. The Rookie always wears the helmet, Johnson never has one.
